onbWelcomeTagline:
Every sip, a sapling.
Drink water and your tree grows; as the days pass, so does your forest.
onbWelcomeNoPenalty: Your tree never withers. No penalties here.
onbGenderSubtitle: Your daily water goal is calculated from this. It all stays on your phone and is never sent anywhere.
onbBodyDisclaimer: For information only, not medical advice.
onbActivitySubtitle: The more you sweat, the more water you need.
onbGoalSubtitle: You can change it anytime in Settings.
onbGoalReference: This goal is adapted to your weight and activity level, based on the adequate water intake reference from the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA, 2010). Water you get from food is not included in this number.
